name: stream pipeline flow
source: import { Readable, Writable, pipeline } from 'node:stream'; function main(): void { let text: string = ''; const output = new Writable({ write(chunk, encoding, done) { text += String(chunk); done(); } }); pipeline(Readable.from(['a', 'b']), output, (error: unknown): void => { console.log(error === undefined, text); }); }
